name: Ownership Transfer Protocol
description: accept なしに Transferred 状態へ到達不可能であることを3層で検証するデモ

intro: Step 1: LLM generates ownership transfer code...
narrative.before: hostile_takeover skips accept and tries Idle → Transferred
narrative.after: InvalidPreState catches the bug before deployment

steps.name: Z3 Bug Detection: hostile_takeover
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the expected rejection diagnostic.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 1 and emits expected rejection evidence (InvalidPreState).

steps.name: Z3 Correct Implementation Verification
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Verification passed).

steps.name: Z3 E2E Test Suite
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the verifier gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Verification passed).

steps.name: Agent Forge Dry Run
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the agent gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (vstd-ownership).

steps.name: Lean Ownership Proof Build
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the Lean proof gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (no required output marker).

steps.name: Lean Bridge Certificate
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (ingested).

harness_contract.intent: Prove that ownership cannot transfer without the accept step and preserve the corrected ownership protocol.
artifact_contracts: Generate evidence: result.json and report.md in reports/{scenario}/latest/ plus per-step logs.
result.json records InvalidPreState rejection, Z3 proof acceptance, E2E verification, agent dry-run, and Lean status.
report.md explains the before/after bug evidence and proof density.
ownership.proof.json is the L1 Z3 proof certificate for the corrected implementation.
ownership.lean-cert.json is the L3 bridge certificate when Lean assets are available.
dashboard/summary.md aggregates PASS and proof-density evidence for the scenario.
Gate order: l1_z3 -> l2_agent -> l3_lean; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Ownership transfer requires an explicit accept transition before Transferred.
success_criteria: Lean build/bridge certifies the optional ownership theorem when available.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: state-machine violation and corrected transition are encoded directly in scenario source and expected diagnostics.
